objective: Map documented requirements, available evidence and missing evidence.

build-evidence-register.expected_when: An explicit project_root is supplied and the routine is due.
build-evidence-register.acceptance: Produces working/evidence-register.md from provided evidence and states blockers and limitations.
build-evidence-register.fallback: Write a blocker artifact; never infer missing evidence.
build-evidence-register.recovery: Re-read current project inputs and continue within this eligible run.
